sessions.prompt:
Add is_freezing(c) to temps.py: True when the Celsius reading c is at or below 0. Add tests.

Project rule, which applies to all work on this project from now on: every temperature that a function in this project returns is in Kelvin (K = C + 273.15), rounded to 2 decimal places, whatever unit its inputs use.

decisions: Every temperature a function returns is in Kelvin (K = C + 273.15), rounded to 2 decimal places, whatever the input unit.
